# Copilot instructions

This is a template repository. Help participants use the template in a
repository created from it; do not create GitHub issues, projects, milestones,
pull requests, releases, or gists in this repository.

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `.instructions.md`. Do not modify `.github/` files,
including agent, prompt, skill, template, and hook files. The sole exception
is an explicitly requested edit to a GitHub Actions workflow.

Keep work focused, ask clarifying questions when needed, and never expose
secrets. Validate changes with the repository's existing tooling before
proposing them.
